pages.title: Grinding
pages.text: Hold $(item)Shears$() in your $(thing)off hand$() and the material in your $(thing)main hand$(), then right click.$(br2)The input is the $(thing)processed$() form: the ingot where one exists, otherwise whatever the ore drops. The dust falls at your feet and the shears take the wear.

pages.title: Yield and wear
pages.text: Cheap ore grinds well, precious ore does not.$(br2)$(li)Coal, Copper, Zinc: 4 dust, 2 wear.$(li)Lapis: 3 dust, 3 wear.$(li)Iron, Gold, Quartz, Amethyst: 2 dust, 4 wear.$(li)Diamond, Emerald: 1 dust, 6 wear.$(li)Netherite: 1 dust, 10 wear.

pages.title: Two exceptions
pages.text: $(thing)Redstone$() has no dust of ours, because the ore already drops one. Feed vanilla Redstone Dust to the chamber directly.$(br2)$(thing)Netherite$() takes the ingot, not scrap. That is four scrap and four gold for a single dust, and it is meant to be the most expensive thing you can attune to.
